verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so serving custom weights or LoRA adapters is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents calling Munito's catalog of models through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Nothing shows uploading custom weights, fine-tunes or LoRA adapters; the mention of routing requests 'to your own cloud' is an adjacent deployment option, not a weight-serving capability.
